content.text: For Nigerian creatives, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/getting-paid-usdt-digital-work-step-step-deployment-2|Getting Paid]] paid through Stripe is a challenge; it's a problem also faced by those in Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, Philippines, and other regions where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-my-unfiltered-take|COREMERCH guide to payment]] platforms like Stripe are unavailable or severely restricted, forcing them to depend on foreign infrastructure and face unpredictable transaction fees, rejection, and isolation. This post explains how to automate digital commerce with [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/google-apps-script-digital-commerce-automation-what-actually-4|google]] Apps Script, NOWPayments, and Cloudflare, without relying on these restrictive platforms, ensuring sovereignty and control over transactions and data.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a powerful tool for digital commerce automation, allowing creatives to build a sovereign digital store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. By using Apps Script, NOWPayments, and Cloudflare, creators can process orders in under 30 seconds, handle 100,000 webhook events per day on the free tier, and send download links automatically after a crypto payment confirms, giving them complete control over their transactions and data. This is particularly important for creatives in regions where Stripe, PayPal, or other payment platforms are unavailable or heavily restricted, as it enables them to operate independently and securely, without relying on foreign infrastructure.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture consists of Google Apps Script as the backend logic, NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, and Cloudflare for hosting and delivery. Apps Script handles the order storage, processing, and delivery logic, while NOWPayments integrates with Cloudflare to verify payments and trigger order fulfillment. Cloudflare handles the hosting, delivery, and SSL encryption, ensuring a secure and seamless experience for customers. By using this architecture, creators can build a fully automated digital store that processes orders in under 30 seconds, without relying on any third-party payment platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creatives in regions where payment platforms like Stripe are unavailable or heavily restricted, such as Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, Philippines, and others. By using Google Apps Script, NOWPayments, and Cloudflare, these creators can build a sovereign digital store that gives them complete control over their transactions and data, enabling them to operate independently and securely, without relying on foreign infrastructure. This is particularly important for creatives who rely on digital commerce for their income and want to minimize the risks associated with payment platform restrictions and fees.

The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this architecture are Google Apps Script, NOWPayments, and Cloudflare. Apps Script handles the backend logic, order storage, and delivery, while NOWPayments integrates with Cloudflare to verify payments and trigger order fulfillment. Cloudflare handles the hosting, delivery, and SSL encryption, ensuring a secure and seamless experience for customers. By using these components together, creators can build a fully automated digital store that processes orders in under 30 seconds, without relying on any third-party payment platforms.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this solution today, creators can start by setting up a Google Apps Script project, integrating NOWPayments with Cloudflare, and configuring the order storage and delivery logic. They can then test the solution with a sandbox environment, deploy it to a live environment, and finally, configure the automatic delivery of digital products after a crypto payment confirms. By following these steps, creators can build a sovereign digital store that gives them complete control over their transactions and data, enabling them to operate independently and securely, without relying on foreign infrastructure.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital delivery works through a specific technical sequence that eliminates every manual step. NOWPayments monitors the blockchain for incoming transactions to your configured wallet address. When a transaction receives the configured number of on-chain confirmations — typically one confirmation on Tron, which takes under 60 seconds — NOWPayments sends an HTTP POST request to the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Your Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script Web App receives this request, validates the webhook signature against the secret key you configured, reads the payment data, confirms the transaction independently on the blockchain, logs the order to your database, and sends the delivery email with a time-limited download link.
By using NOWPayments, creators can process orders in under 30 seconds, handle 100,000 webhook events per day on the free tier, and send download links automatically after a crypto payment confirms.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy this solution today, take the following steps: Set up a Google Apps Script project and integrate NOWPayments with Cloudflare; Configure the order storage and delivery logic; Test the solution with a sandbox environment; Deploy it to a live environment; Configure the automatic delivery of digital products after a crypto payment confirms; Set up a webhook to trigger order fulfillment; Integrate Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script with Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage; Use NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification; Configure Cloudflare or Google Drive for file delivery; Set up SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for email deliverability; Test the solution end-to-end before handoff.
Frequently Asked Questions
How does Google Apps Script handle order storage and delivery?

Google Apps Script handles order storage and delivery logic, allowing creators to store and process orders quickly and securely, and deliver digital products automatically after a crypto payment confirms.
What is a webhook and how does it trigger order fulfillment?
A webhook is a notification sent by NOWPayments to Cloudflare when a payment confirms on-chain, triggering order fulfillment and ensuring a seamless experience for customers.
Can I use Cloudflare Workers instead of Google Apps Script?
Yes, you can use Cloudflare Workers instead of Google Apps Script, but you'll need to integrate it with NOWPayments and configure the order storage and delivery logic accordingly.
How much does NOWPayments cost?
NOWPayments charges a fee of 0.5% per transaction, making it a cost-effective option for digital creators.
Can I use this solution with other payment platforms?
No, this solution is designed to work with NOWPayments, which provides automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, and is not compatible with other payment platforms like Stripe.
